change_ref: OpenSpec change image-based-rescue-gate (Experiment 43, issue #161). This pilot runs before Experiment 43 and does not change its plan.
question: Given a page image and the rescued text of that page, does the model's yes/no answer to 'Does the text match the text written or printed on the page image?' separate a junk text layer from a faithful one?
decision: Whether Experiment 43 starts with this question wording and these render settings, starts only after a runtime fix, or does not start as designed.

hypotheses.statement: On the local arm, the median P(yes) for faithful text minus the median P(yes) for wrong text (text of another page) is at least 0.5 over all 30 pages.
hypotheses.null: The difference is smaller than 0.5, or goes the other way: the model does not use the image to judge the text.

hypotheses.statement: On the local arm, P(yes) ranks faithful text above the junk LiteParse layer on the 7 junk pages with AUC at least 0.9.
hypotheses.null: AUC is below 0.9: the question does not separate a junk layer from faithful text on the same page.

decision_rule: If H1 and H2 both hold on the local arm, Experiment 43 starts with this wording and these render settings as its Stage 1 starting point. If H1 holds and H2 fails, Experiment 43 does not start until its plan is revised (more wordings or another signal). If H1 fails, read the hosted arm: if the hosted arm passes G1, fix the local runtime and run this pilot again; if the hosted arm also fails G1, Experiment 43 does not start as designed.

A_local.model: Clef-Flash Q8_0 plus mmproj-Clef-Flash-Q8_0.gguf on llama-server build 11941
A_local.endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1/systemone (loopback only, one request at a time)
A_local.pages: all 30 pages in pages.junk and pages.healthy

B_hosted.model: jev-latest with image input; response model id recorded per page
B_hosted.key: read from the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable; never printed, logged or saved
B_hosted.pages: the 23 pages in pages.healthy only (open licence, no named-person records). The 7 rf06 and rf07 pages are excluded, because they hold named-person records. They may go to the hosted arm only after the operator approves it in a dated entry in amendments.
B_hosted.wrong_text_source: healthy pages only, so no rf06 or rf07 text reaches the hosted arm

request.question: Does the text match the text written or printed on the page image?
request.text_head_rule: the first 2000 characters of the text variant, after Unicode NFC; no other cleaning

render.rule: render at 150 DPI with pypdfium2; if the long side is above 1600 px, scale down to 1600 px (Lanczos), keep the aspect ratio
render.llama_server_image_tokens: follow Experiment 43 design D4 (--image-min-tokens 4, --image-max-tokens 14400) when the projector accepts them, else the server defaults; record what ran in the run record

text_variants.junk: the LiteParse text layer of the page, the text the rescue chain (ADR-066) returns today. Scored only on the 7 junk pages.
text_variants.faithful: junk pages: the dots.mocr transcription in the sibling worktree omrs-feat-dots-mocr-llamacpp-backend, ocr-workers/engines/dots-mocr-llamacpp/smoke_evidence/parity-pages/<doc>-p<NNN>.md (hashes in frozen). Healthy pages: the page's own text layer from pdftotext, which Experiment 33 labelled usable with token recall at least 0.95.
text_variants.wrong: the faithful text of the next page in the same group (junk or healthy, in the listed order, cyclic) that comes from a different document

pages.source: Experiment 33 corpus (experiments/33-ocr-routing-natural-positive-2026-09-17/corpus/natural/, copy under ~/Development/DATA/omrs/experiments/33-ocr-routing-natural-positive-2026-09-17/) with frozen labels
pages.healthy_rule: for each document in strata born_digital (bd), mixed (mx) and scan_with_text_layer (tl): the lowest page above 1 with Experiment 33 label usable, r_best >= 0.95 and reference_tokens >= 100. tl06 has no such page. Result: 23 pages, all open licence (CC BY, US government work, US patent).

gates.value: local arm, 7 junk pages, 49 faithful-junk pairs, ties count 0.5

analysis.g1: median over pages of P(yes | faithful) minus median over pages of P(yes | wrong). Report the 95% paired bootstrap interval of the per-page difference with _lib/stats.py paired_bootstrap_ci (seed 0). The gate uses the point value.
analysis.g2: Mann-Whitney AUC: share of (faithful, junk) page pairs where P(yes | faithful) > P(yes | junk), ties 0.5. With 7 pages per side, report it as a point value only.
analysis.hosted: G1 on the 23 healthy pages, reported beside the local value. It does not decide.
analysis.exploratory: per-page tables, P(yes) for faithful healthy text, seconds per request. Any other comparison is labelled exploratory.

runtime_checks: R1: GET /props on the local server; the build number must be 11941.
R2: verify_llamacpp_runtime from experiments/_lib/llamacpp_runtime.py checks the build and the SHA-256 of Clef-Flash-Q8_0.gguf against runtime.models.

R3: the runner hashes mmproj-Clef-Flash-Q8_0.gguf itself and compares it with frozen (the shared check reads only the --model file). It also confirms that the server command line holds --mmproj with that file.

R4: wrong-text smoke test on rf06 page 29: one request with its faithful text, one with its wrong text. P(yes | faithful) must be above P(yes | wrong) by at least 0.2. This also shows the projector is loaded.
R5: hosted arm only: the same smoke test on bd01 page 2, with the key read from TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Never print the key.
stopping_rules: Stop before any score if R1, R2 or R3 fails. Record the found value. Do not change the build or files without an amendment.
Stop before any score if R4 fails. Status stays PLANNED and the report names the failure. Experiment 43 does not start until the image path works.
Stop the hosted arm on any 401, 403 or quota error. The local arm continues.
If more than 3 of the 67 local requests fail after 2 retries each, stop. The result is INCONCLUSIVE.
Score each page and variant once. No reruns to improve a value. A rerun after a crash uses --resume and keeps the earlier scores.

outcome_table.G1 pass, G2 pass: PASS. Experiment 43 starts with this wording and these render settings as its Stage 1 starting point.
outcome_table.G1 pass, G2 fail: FAIL. The model reads the image but does not catch junk layers. Revise the Experiment 43 plan before it starts (more wordings, or another signal).
outcome_table.G1 fail, hosted G1 pass: FAIL for the local runtime. Fix the local image path (projector, token limits, build) and run this pilot again before Experiment 43.
outcome_table.G1 fail, hosted G1 fail: FAIL. The question does not work. Experiment 43 does not start as designed.

cloud: Hosted arm B only, healthy open-licence pages only, key from TYPESAFE_API_KEY. rf06 and rf07 page images and text never go to a hosted service without a dated operator amendment.
